heading: Simplified delivery management with organized address categories and color-coded status filters

blocks.html: I integrated the final card design into the task list page, where broader address categories serve as folders to organize individual package details, simplifying delivery management with a clear hierarchy. The use of consistent colors for status pills in the status card system enhances ease for drivers in filtering options such as "out for delivery" and managing package statuses.

blocks.alt: Espoirer — Simplified delivery management with organized address categories and color-coded status filters

blocks.html: 👍 Aggregate the task lists by broader address.
